mapper.select: SELECT commit_time time,area area,total,normal,abnormal,id FROM traffic_nmsserver_statistic ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ifnull(d.entrance_id,0) as area,'INOCTETS' as type,sum(tt.incount) as count ,time FROM ( SELECT if((b.INOCTETS - a.INOCTETS ) >0 ,b.INOCTETS - a.INOCTETS ,b.INOCTETS) as incount, b.ip2 as ip, #{push} time FROM (SELECT sum(INOCTETS) INOCTETS,NODE_IP ip1 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{before} and RECV_TIME< #{start} GROUP BY ip1) a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT sum(INOCTETS) INOCTETS,NODE_IP ip2 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{start} and RECV_TIME< #{end} GROUP BY ip2) b on a.ip1=b.ip2 ) tt LEFT JOIN (select entrance_id,manager_ip FROM ntc_device_info ) d on d.manager_ip = tt.ip GROUP BY area UNION ALL SELECT ifnull(d.entrance_id,0) as area,'OUTOCTETS' as type,sum(tt.outcount) as count,time FROM ( SELECT if((b.OUTOCTETS - a.OUTOCTETS ) >0 ,b.OUTOCTETS - a.OUTOCTETS ,b.OUTOCTETS) as outcount, b.ip2 as ip, #{push} time FROM (SELECT sum(OUTOCTETS) OUTOCTETS,NODE_IP ip1 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{before} and RECV_TIME< #{start} GROUP BY ip1) a RIGHT JOIN (SELECT sum(OUTOCTETS) OUTOCTETS,NODE_IP ip2 FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{start} and RECV_TIME< #{end} GROUP BY ip2) b on a.ip1=b.ip2 ) tt LEFT JOIN (select entrance_id,manager_ip FROM ntc_device_info group by entrance_id,manager_ip) d on d.manager_ip = tt.ip GROUP BY area
